short: A Confederate ironclad built from the sunken remains of the USS Merrimack.
full:
In 1861, Confederate forces salvaged the scuttled hull of the steam frigate USS Merrimack, raising it and constructing a heavy iron casemate over the deck. Rechristened the CSS Virginia, she was equipped with a cast-iron ram and heavy naval artillery. She proved virtually impervious to the shot of standard wooden Union warships.

On 8 March 1862, she devastated the Union blockading squadron at Hampton Roads, sinking two major vessels. The following day, she fought the USS Monitor to a tactical draw in history's first clash of ironclads. Just two months later, as Union forces advanced on Norfolk, she was scuttled by her own crew to prevent her capture.
